The closest cross-boundary CO2 price parameters actually present are:

- **`pm_taxCO2eqSum`** — the total CO2 price summed from `pm_taxCO2eq` + `pm_taxCO2eqRegi` (from `46_carbonpriceRegi`) + `pm_taxCO2eqSCC` (from `51_internalizeDamages`), assembled in `core/presolve.gms`.
